notes.title: Continuum will release soon on Steam !
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35036993/647d8c46169eb9b04630f01621c78a221ae5ad7a.png[/img]
If you are reading this message, that means Continuum is now visible on Steam! The Release date of the game is on May 27th for both MacOS and Windows.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35036993/aea082f11eb92d7c74157765eda5313bffbe7ee3.png[/img]
Continuum is a lightweight and simple game where you move around in different directions to avoid swarms of never-ending obstacles that fly right towards you. The game requires focus and fast-reaction, test and see how far you can journey into the Continuum. It is a small little game you can play in your spare times to relief from stress and just to relax. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35036993/824c46d6b4e9dfc2a6cc5faf59213585ad56af01.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35036993/c378c84257cbe2729121cf61ac3b9923eecb4df4.png[/img]
Continuum is going to release on Steam for both MacOS and Windows on May 27th. This game will receive frequent updates based on the feedback and suggestions given by the Community. Purchasable DLCs will also release along the regular updates. A Linux build of the game and localization will come along future updates.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35036993/425244f337a84d7a449c2dc1bd90d3e46ccab95f.png[/img]
Continuum is charged at 0.99$ on Steam with 40% discount upon release. Two purchasable DLCs will also be available with the game’s release - The Original SoundTracks and One Content Pack (including more obstacles, game modes and music for the game).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35036993/efd336e3f57852732f049bcd2b83cbfe1979c3df.png[/img]
Since the game is releasing soon on Steam, why not give some keys away? Join Our [url=https://discord.gg/udwBPFP] Discord Server[/url] and simply ask us for a steam key!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35036993/3f41abc5c4c098038d9b36cf0c33bba58441adff.png[/img]
I am currently working on improving the stability and gameplay of the game. You can always check the Steam Community Hub and our [url=https://discord.gg/udwBPFP] Discord Server[/url] for updates of the game!   For now, Thank you and I hope you have a good day.
